pages.text: There are several ways to control the target area that the Builder will affect.
You can directly enter the size and offset in the Shape Card.$(br2)The offset is always relative to the Builder. An offset of 0,0,0 places the area with the Builder in the center.
You can also sneak-right-click a Builder to start area selection, or set the size in the Shape Card and use the anchor buttons in the GUI to control the offset.
